messages:
anna-support: Heads up — Kallo Systems (acct KS-987) put billing on hold. AP portal rejects our invoice until we provide an "Authorization Code" (their portal token). They also flagged a VAT name mismatch (our profile: 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' vs their expected 'Redwood Inference LLC'). Sending proforma didn't help, they specifically want the portal OCN before final invoicing.

mike-finance: Copy. Do we have an example of the Authorization Code format or where it appears in the portal?

anna-support: Customer pasted this in chat: "Authorization Code (OCN): 8A4K9-XXXX-1F3Q (12-char alnum with hyphens) — auto-generated when vendor is successfully registered in their eProcurement portal". Portal shows a validation error referencing tax name.

ben-cs: @anna-support can you ask for a screenshot of the exact portal error and the field they say is mismatched? If it's a strict string match, we'll need documents.

anna-support: Asked for screenshot + portal link. Also asked whether procurement will accept a manual PO number instead of the portal OCN — they answered no, it's a hard requirement from AP.

olivia-sales: If the tax name mismatch is the reason, legal might have a DBA or VAT registration that satisfies them. @lex-legal any quick guidance on matching vendor display name vs tax/legal name?

lex-legal: We have DBA paperwork and EU VAT registration that lists the legal trading name variant. I'll prep a redacted VAT cert and a short attestation we can send. Note: some portals require the exact string on the certificate to match the vendor profile.

mike-finance: Please attach the redacted VAT cert. Also confirm if they require W-8/W-9 or local tax docs. If portal enforces exact text, updating our vendor profile may be fastest. That can take 48-72 business hours depending on the customer's vendor onboarding flow.

billing-bot: Automated note: verify vendor legal name matches customer portal before final invoice. Suggestion: upload redacted tax docs to vendor portal and request re-run to obtain OCN. :white_check_mark:

anna-support: Customer responded with screenshot — error text: "Vendor not registered — generate Authorization Code" and an inline note: "Tax Name mismatch: expected 'Redwood Inference LLC'". Screenshot attached.

ben-cs: Proposed next steps: 1) finance to upload redacted VAT cert and any tax forms, 2) sales to request or update vendor display name in their portal, 3) support to hold invoice until OCN is issued by customer's portal. Who will own coordination?

olivia-sales: I will own vendor profile update and coordinate with the customer's AP. @anna-support please share the portal invite link and AP contact.

mike-finance: I'll prepare redacted W-8/W-9 and the VAT cert for upload. Also confirm what invoice fields must exactly match (company name vs tax name) once we see portal UI.

lex-legal: Uploading redacted VAT cert to thread now. Recommend adding a bracketed alias if portal allows: e.g., 'Redwood Inference LLC (dba Redwood Inference)'. If they require legal name only, we may need a vendor name change.

anna-support: Looping back to customer: "We're preparing the requested docs and will update vendor profile. Please re-run vendor registration once we confirm name update. We'll hold final invoice until you provide the Authorization Code (OCN)." :thumbsup:

olivia-sales: ETA for name update after we have confirmation from customer ~ 48-72 hours. I'll update this thread with progress and any portal messages.

mike-finance: If they ask for an interim payment option we can provide a proforma invoice or partial invoice, but can't push to accounts receivable until OCN is present.

anna-support: Noted. Closing loop for now; reopening when OCN received or if customer escalates. cc @billing-bot
